title: OpenRT: An Open-Source Red Teaming Framework for Multimodal LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark (OpenRT) is a framework for evaluating the safety of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) against various jailbreaking attacks, focusing on general harmfulness categories like cybercrime, illegal activities, and misinformation.
findings: The paper makes no findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the study.
